prompt: A tiny compact flat toy railgun lying flat side down, seen from above at a 3/4 angle: a narrow opaque grey plastic strip as the base, two thin opaque orange plastic rails on top hugging the dart tightly on both sides, two small copper wire coils around the rails, a tiny black battery block at the back. The dart between the rails is a paperclip that has been fully unbent into one long nearly straight silver wire, with only one or two small wiggles left, sharpened to a point at the front; it is NOT a folded paperclip, no loops. The whole thing is barely wider than the wire. Shown alone, single object centred, plain cream background, soft studio light, no text, no logos, no grip, no tape, no stand. Glossy opaque molded plastic like a piece snapped off a toy soldier set. Small, compact and simple with few parts.
